description: High-scoring students in UG and PG programmes receive a partial tuition waiver based on a deterministic academic score.
Students from non-metro cities receive support against tuition and development fees.
Female students in Engineering and Computing programmes receive a government-backed tuition subsidy.
Students with a strong extracurricular score receive a fixed grant against sports, tuition, and development fees.
PG and PhD students in research-oriented programmes receive support for research and library-related fees.
